title.zh: 卷二 宋本紀中第二 文帝 孝武帝 前廢帝
title.en: Volume 2 Liu Song Annals 2: Emperor Wen, Emperor Xiaowu, Former Deposed Emperor
title.raw: 卷二 宋本紀中第二 文帝 孝武帝 前廢帝 Volume 2 Liu Song Annals 2: Emperor Wen, Emperor Xiaowu, Former Deposed Emperor

sentences.zh: 宋本紀中第二

translations.literal: Liu Song Annals, middle scroll, second.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Song Annals, Part Two.

sentences.zh: 景平初，有黑龍見西方，五色雲隨之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingping, a black dragon appeared in the west, and five-colored clouds followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jingping era, a black dragon was seen in the west, with five-colored clouds trailing after it.

sentences.zh: 二年，江陵城上有紫雲。

translations.literal: In the second year, on Jiangling's walls there was purple cloud.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, purple clouds appeared above the walls of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 望氣者皆以為帝王之符，當在西方。

translations.literal: Those who read the aura all took it as the omen of an emperor, and that it ought to be in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Court diviners of celestial signs all interpreted these as imperial portents pointing westward.

sentences.zh: 其年少帝廢，百官議所立，徐羨之、傅亮等以禎符所集，備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。

translations.literal: At that time the young emperor was deposed; the hundred officials deliberated whom to install. Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and others, because the auspicious signs had gathered, prepared the imperial equipage to go welcome him, and he entered to receive the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the young emperor was deposed, the officials debated who should succeed him. Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang, and others, taking the auspicious signs as confirmation, went out with full imperial escort to welcome him and install him on the throne.

sentences.zh: 行台至江陵，尚書令傅亮奉表進璽紱，州府佐吏並稱臣，請題榜諸門，一依宮省，上皆不許。

translations.literal: When the traveling office reached Jiangling, the Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang presented a memorial offering the seal and cord; the aides of the province and prefecture all styled themselves ministers and asked to inscribe placards on every gate, all according to the palace administration—the sovereign would not permit any of it.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial mission reached Jiangling, Fu Liang, as Director of the Masters of Writing, presented a memorial offering the seal and cord of office. Provincial and prefectural staff all declared themselves his ministers and asked to hang palace-style placards on every gate; he refused every request.

sentences.zh: 教州、府、國綱紀宥所統內見刑。

translations.literal: He ordered that within the jurisdictions of provinces, prefectures, and princedoms, the statutes should pardon those under sentence within their borders.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered provinces, prefectures, and princedoms to grant amnesty within their jurisdictions to prisoners already under sentence.

sentences.zh: 是時，司空徐羨之等新有弑害，及鑾駕西迎，人懷疑懼，惟長史王曇首、司馬王華、南蠻校尉到彥之共期朝臣未有異志。

translations.literal: At this time the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi and others had newly committed regicide; when the imperial carriage went west to welcome the heir, people harbored doubt and fear. Only the Chief Administrator Wang Tanshou, the Major Wang Hua, and the Colonel of Southern Man Dao Yanzhi together expected that the court ministers had no other intent.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xianzhi and the other regents had only recently carried out a regicide, and as the imperial escort went west to fetch the new ruler, many were anxious. Only Wang Tanshou, Wang Hua, and Dao Yanzhi were confident that the court ministers would not waver.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「諸公受遺，不容背貳；

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "The lords received the testamentary charge; they cannot bear to turn disloyal;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "These men accepted a deathbed charge—they will not betray it;

sentences.zh: 且勞臣舊將，內外充滿，今兵力又足以制物，夫何所疑！」

translations.literal: moreover, the toiling ministers and old generals fill court and camp within and without; now our military strength is also sufficient to control events—what is there to doubt!"
translations.idiomatic: and veteran ministers and generals fill every post at court and in the field. Our forces are more than enough to hold the realm—what is there to fear?"

sentences.zh: 甲戌，乃發江陵，命王華知州府，留鎮陝西，令到彥之監襄陽。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he set out from Jiangling, ordered Wang Hua to administer the province and prefecture, left him to garrison western Shaanxi, and commanded Dao Yanzhi to supervise Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu he departed Jiangling, leaving Wang Hua to govern the province and prefecture and garrison western Shaanxi, while Dao Yanzhi was posted to oversee Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 車駕在道，有黑龍躍負上所乘舟，左右莫不失色，上謂王曇首曰：「此乃夏禹所以受天命，我何德以堪之。

translations.literal: While the carriage was on the road, a black dragon leaped and bore up the boat the sovereign was riding; those left and right all lost color. The sovereign said to Wang Tanshou, "This is how Yu of Xia received Heaven's mandate—what virtue have I to bear it?
translations.idiomatic: On the journey a black dragon leaped onto the imperial boat and bore it along; everyone around him turned pale. He told Wang Tanshou, "This is how Yu of Xia received Heaven's mandate—what virtue have I to deserve such a sign?

sentences.zh: 」及至都，群臣迎拜於新亭。

translations.literal: " When he reached the capital, the host of ministers welcomed and bowed at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: " When he reached the capital, the officials welcomed him with obeisance at Xinting.

sentences.zh: 先謁初寧陵，還次中堂，百官奉璽紱，沖讓未受，勸請數四，乃從之。

translations.literal: He first paid visit to Chuning Mausoleum, then returned and halted at the Central Hall; the hundred officials presented the seal and cord. He declined and did not accept; they urged him several times, and only then did he assent.
translations.idiomatic: He first visited Chuning Mausoleum, then returned to the Central Hall, where officials presented the seal and cord. He refused several times before finally accepting.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，皇帝即位于中堂，備法駕入宮，禦太極前殿，大赦，改元，文武賜位二等。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou of the first year of Yuanjia, the Emperor took the throne at the Central Hall, with full imperial equipage entered the palace, ascended the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed a great amnesty, changed the era name, and bestowed two ranks on civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eighth month of the first Yuanjia year, the emperor took the throne in the Central Hall, entered the palace with full imperial ceremony, took his seat in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate, proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and raised civil and military officials two ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，拜太廟。

translations.literal: On wuxu he worshiped at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he performed rites at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔追復廬陵王先封，奉迎靈柩。

translations.literal: An edict restored the former enfeoffment of the Prince of Luling and ordered his coffin brought in.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored the Prince of Luling's former title and ordered his coffin brought to the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，謁臨川烈武王陵。

translations.literal: On xinchou he visited the tomb of the Martially King of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he visited the tomb of the Martially King of Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，進司空徐羨之位司徒，江州刺史王弘位司空，尚書令傅亮左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On guimao he promoted the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi to Grand Tutor, Wang Hong of Jingzhou to Minister of Works, and the Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang to Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with the privilege of an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he promoted Xu Xianzhi from Minister of Works to Grand Tutor, Wang Hong of Jingzhou to Minister of Works, and Fu Liang from Director of the Masters of Writing to Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為章皇太后，封皇弟義恭為江夏王，義宣為竟陵王，義季為衡陽王。

translations.literal: On jiachen he posthumously honored his birth mother, Lady Hu, as Grand Empress Dowager Zhang, and enfeoffed his younger brothers Yigong as Prince of Jiangxia, Yixuan as Prince of Jingling, and Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he posthumously honored his birth mother, Lady Hu, as Grand Empress Dowager Zhang, and enfeoffed his brothers Yigong as Prince of Jiangxia, Yixuan as Prince of Jingling, and Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。

translations.literal: On jiyou he reduced this year's cloth tax of Jing and Xiang provinces by half.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he halved the year's cloth tax for Jing and Xiang provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingzi, he installed Consort Yuan as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingzi, he installed Consort Yuan as empress.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏太武皇帝始光元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Shiguang of the Northern Wei Emperor Taiwu.
translations.idiomatic: That year corresponded to the first year of Shiguang under the Northern Wei's Emperor Taiwu.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽萬機。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on bingyin, the Grand Tutor Xu Xianzhi and the Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang presented a memorial returning government; the sovereign for the first time personally reviewed the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on bingyin, Grand Tutor Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang submitted memorials returning power, and the emperor personally took up the reins of government for the first time.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinwei he sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康以本號開府儀同三司，改授司空王弘車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, with his present title opened an office with privilege equal to the Three Dukes; the Minister of Works Wang Hong was transferred to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, Prince Yikang of Pengcheng, General of Agile Cavalry and inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was granted an office equal to the Three Dukes; Wang Hong was transferred from Minister of Works to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with the same privilege.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，以武都王世子楊玄為北秦州刺史，襲封武都王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Yang Xuan, heir of the King of Wudu, was made Inspector of Northern Qinzhou and succeeded to the title King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Yang Xuan, heir of the King of Wudu, was appointed inspector of Northern Qinzhou and succeeded to the title King of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，赫連屈丐死。

translations.literal: That year Helian Qubug died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Helian Qubug died.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, on bingyin, the Grand Tutor Xu Xianzhi and the Director of the Masters of Writing Fu Liang were guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on bingyin, Xu Xianzhi and Fu Liang were found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。

translations.literal: He dispatched the Central Palace Commander Dao Yanzhi and the General Who Pacifies the North Tan Daoji to attack Xie Hui, Inspector of Jingzhou; the sovereign personally led the Six Armies on a western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji against Xie Hui, inspector of Jingzhou, while he personally led the Six Armies westward.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On dingmao he made Wang Hong of Jingzhou Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he appointed Wang Hong of Jingzhou Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuwu, he made the Grandee of Splendid Honors with the Golden Seal Wang Jinghong Director of the Masters of Writing, Left Vice Director, and Zheng Xianzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuwu, he made Wang Jinghong, Grandee of Splendid Honors with the Golden Seal, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Zheng Xianzhi, administrator of Yuzhang, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。

translations.literal: On wuchen Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji greatly defeated Xie Hui at Yinji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji routed Xie Hui at Yinji.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反旆。

translations.literal: On bingzi the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor turned back from Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禽晦於延頭，送都伏誅。

translations.literal: On jimao Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiwei, he made the General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Tan Daoji General Who Conquers the South, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei, Tan Daoji was promoted from General Who Pacifies the North to General Who Conquers the South, with privilege equal to the Three Dukes, and made inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大且渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On yisi the General of Agile Cavalry and Governor of Liangzhou Juqu Mengxun was changed to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Juqu Mengxun, General of Agile Cavalry and governor of Liangzhou, was promoted to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔大使巡行四方，觀省風俗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grand envoys to tour the four quarters and observe local customs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dispatched grand envoys to tour the realm and report on local customs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，臨延賢堂聽訟，自是每歲三訊。

translations.literal: On bingwu he heard cases at the Hall for Extending Worthies; from this year there were three annual sessions of judicial review.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he heard lawsuits at the Hall for Extending Worthies; thereafter he held three judicial sessions each year.

sentences.zh: 秋，旱且蝗。

translations.literal: In autumn there was drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought drought and locusts.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, the former Administrator of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Xu Peizhi, former administrator of Wu commandery, was executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦建鄴百里內。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of the fourth year, yihai, a partial amnesty was granted within a hundred li of Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On the new year's day, yihai, of the fourth year, a partial amnesty was granted within a hundred li of Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinsi he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, he traveled to Dantu and visited the capital tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, he traveled to Dantu and visited the imperial tombs there.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，宴丹徒宮，帝鄉父老咸與焉。

translations.literal: On bingzi he feasted at the Dantu palace; elders of the emperor's native district all attended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he held a feast at the Dantu palace, with elders from his home district in attendance.

sentences.zh: 蠲丹徒今年租布，原五歲刑以下。

translations.literal: He remitted Dantu's cloth tax for the year and pardoned punishments up to five years.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted Dantu's cloth tax for the year and pardoned offenses punishable by up to five years' labor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Zheng Xianzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zheng Xianzhi, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，采富陽令諸葛闡議，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬。

translations.literal: On renyin he adopted the proposal of Zhuge Chan, magistrate of Fuyang, forbidding on the summer solstice the five-colored silk life-cords and the like.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he adopted a proposal by Zhuge Chan, magistrate of Fuyang, banning five-colored silk life-cords and similar items on the summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，都下疾疫，遣使存問，給醫藥，死無家屬者，賜以棺器。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, pestilence struck the capital; he sent envoys to inquire after the people, provided medicine, and for the dead without kin he bestowed coffins.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month plague struck the capital; he sent officials to inquire after the sick, supplied medicine, and provided coffins for the dead who had no family.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, guimao, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the first day of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，詔以陰陽愆序，求讜言。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on yihai, an edict was issued because yin and yang were out of order, seeking forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on yihai of the fifth year, he issued an edict inviting candid counsel because heaven and earth were out of harmony.

sentences.zh: 甲申，臨玄武館閱武。

translations.literal: On jiashen he reviewed troops at the Black Tortoise Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he reviewed troops at the Black Tortoise Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 戊子，都下大火，遣使巡慰振恤。

translations.literal: On wuzi a great fire broke out in the capital; he sent envoys to tour, comfort, and relieve.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a great fire broke out in the capital; he sent officials to comfort victims and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 夏六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衛將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on gengxu, the Grand Tutor Wang Hong was reduced to General of the Guard with an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, Grand Tutor Wang Hong was demoted to General of the Guard with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 都下大水。

translations.literal: A great flood struck the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使檢行振贍。

translations.literal: On yimao he sent envoys to inspect, relieve, and sustain.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he sent officials to inspect the damage and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月，天竺國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the state of Tianzhu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Tianzhu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏神鹿元年，太武皇帝伐赫連昌，滅之。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Shenlu of Wei; the Emperor Taiwu attacked Helian Chang and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first Shenlu year of Wei; Emperor Taiwu attacked Helian Chang and destroyed his state.

sentences.zh: 乞伏熾盤死。

translations.literal: Qifu Chipan died.
translations.idiomatic: Qifu Chipan died.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, on xinchou, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinchou of the sixth year, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On guichou he made the Inspector of Jingzhou, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Prince Yikang of Pengcheng, inspector of Jingzhou, was made Grand Tutor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingsi, he installed the imperial son Shao as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, he installed his son Shao as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: On wuwu a great amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officials were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he proclaimed a general amnesty and raised civil and military officials one rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, he made the Left Vice Director Wang Jinghong Director of the Masters of Writing, the Prince of Linchuan Yiqing Left Vice Director, and the Minister of Personnel Jiang Yi Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guihai, Wang Jinghong became Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Yiqing of Linchuan Left Vice Director, and Jiang Yi, Minister of Personnel, Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, renchen, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the first day of the fifth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, the state of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之，星晝見。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, jichou, there was an eclipse of the sun, and stars were visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the first day of the eleventh month, the sun was eclipsed and stars could be seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 十二月，河西、河南國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the states west and east of the River both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the states west and east of the Yellow River both sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 七年春二月壬戌，雪且雷。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, on renxu, there was snow and also thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu of the seventh year, snow fell amid thunder.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，遣右將軍到彥之侵魏。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuzi, he dispatched the General of the Right Dao Yanzhi to invade Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, he sent General of the Right Dao Yanzhi to invade Wei.

sentences.zh: 夏六月己卯，封氐楊難當為武都王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on jimao, he enfeoffed the Di chieftain Yang nandang as King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, he enfeoffed the Di leader Yang nandang as King of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，立錢署，鑄四銖錢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, he established a Bureau of Coinage and cast four-zhu coins.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuwu, he established a Bureau of Coinage and cast four-zhu coins.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，魏克金墉城。

translations.literal: On wuyin Wei captured Jinyong city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Wei captured Jinyong.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，又克虎牢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao, they again captured Hulao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, Wei also captured Hulao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣征南大將軍檀道濟拒魏，

translations.literal: On renchen he dispatched the General Who Conquers the South Tan Daoji to resist Wei,
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he sent General Who Conquers the South Tan Daoji to resist Wei,

sentences.zh: 右將軍到彥之自滑台奔退。

translations.literal: and the General of the Right Dao Yanzhi fled in retreat from Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: while General of the Right Dao Yanzhi retreated in disorder from Huatai.

sentences.zh: 十二月，都下火，延燒於太社北牆。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, fire broke out in the capital and spread to the north wall of the Grand Soil altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month fire broke out in the capital and burned as far as the north wall of the Grand Soil altar.

sentences.zh: 是歲，馮跋死。

translations.literal: That year Feng Ba died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Feng Ba died.

sentences.zh: 倭、百濟、呵羅單、林邑、呵羅他、師子等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Wa, Baekje, Heluodan, Linyi, Heluota, Shizi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Wa, Baekje, Heluodan, Linyi, Heluota, Shizi, and other states all sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 吳興、晉陵、義興大水，遣使巡行振恤。

translations.literal: Wuxing, Jinling, and Yixing suffered great floods; he sent envoys to tour, relieve, and sustain.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxing, Jinling, and Yixing suffered severe flooding; he sent officials to tour the region and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 八年春二月辛酉，魏克滑台。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, on xinyou, Wei captured Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou of the eighth year, Wei captured Huatai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，檀道濟引軍還，自是河南復亡。

translations.literal: On guiyou Tan Daoji led the army back; from this the lands south of the River were again lost.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Tan Daoji withdrew his army, and the territory south of the Yellow River was lost again.

sentences.zh: 三月，大雩。

translations.literal: In the third month, a great rain sacrifice was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he performed a great rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 夏六月乙丑，大赦，旱故。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on yichou, a great amnesty was proclaimed because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yichou, he proclaimed a general amnesty on account of drought.

sentences.zh: 又大雩。

translations.literal: Again a great rain sacrifice was held.
translations.idiomatic: He performed another great rain sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 閏六月乙巳，遣使省行獄訟，簡息徭役。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on yisi, he sent envoys to review prison cases and lighten corvée and levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on yisi, he sent officials to review criminal cases and lighten corvée and tax burdens.

sentences.zh: 九年春二月辛卯，詔曰：「故太傅長沙景王、故大司馬臨川烈武王、故司徒南康文宣公穆之、衛將軍華容公弘、征南大將軍永修公道濟、故左將軍龍陽侯鎮惡，或履道廣深、執德沖邈；

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, on xinmao, an edict said: "The former Grand Tutor, the Prince of Changsha, King Jing; the former Grand Marshal, the Martially King of Linchuan; the former Minister of Works, the Duke of Literary Accomplishment of Nankang, Muzhi; the Duke of Splendid Accomplishment of Huarong, Hong; the General Who Conquers the South, the Duke of Yongxiu, Daoji; the former General of the Left, the Marquis of Longyang, Zhen'e—some trod the Way broad and deep and held virtue modest and remote;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinmao of the ninth year, an edict read: "The late Grand Tutor, Prince Jing of Changsha; the late Grand Marshal, the Martially King of Linchuan; the late Minister of Works, Duke Muzhi of Nankang; Duke Hong of Huarong; General Who Conquers the South Duke Daoji of Yongxiu; and the late General of the Left, Marquis Zhen'e of Longyang—some walked a path of deep principle and modest virtue;

sentences.zh: 或雅量高劭，風鑒明遠；

translations.literal: some bore lofty measure and clear, far-seeing judgment;
translations.idiomatic: others bore lofty character and far-seeing judgment;

sentences.zh: 或識准弘正，才略開邁。

translations.literal: some had insight correct and vast, talent and strategy broad and advancing.
translations.idiomatic: still others combined penetrating insight with bold strategic talent.

sentences.zh: 咸文德以弘帝載，武功以隆景業。

translations.literal: All with civil virtue enlarged the emperor's carriage and with martial achievement raised the glorious enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: All of them enlarged the civil foundation of the dynasty and strengthened its martial achievements.

sentences.zh: 而太常未銘，從祀闕享，寤寐屬慮，永言興懷。

translations.literal: Yet the Grand Steward has not inscribed them, and in collateral sacrifice they lack offering; waking and sleeping I fix my thought on this, and long speak it with rising feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Yet their names are not recorded in the temple registers, nor do they receive collateral sacrifice—this weighs on me waking and sleeping.

sentences.zh: 便宜配祭廟庭，勒功天府。」

translations.literal: It is fitting that they be matched in sacrifice in the temple court and their achievements carved in the Hall of Heaven's Storehouse."
translations.idiomatic: Let them be honored with collateral sacrifice in the ancestral temple and their deeds inscribed in the Hall of Heaven's Storehouse."

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，進衛將軍王弘為太保。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengxu, he promoted the General of the Guard Wang Hong to Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengxu, General of the Guard Wang Hong was promoted to Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，加江州刺史檀道濟為司空。

translations.literal: On dingsi he added to Tan Daoji, Inspector of Jingzhou, the rank of Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Tan Daoji, inspector of Jingzhou, was additionally appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬申，新除太保王弘薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renshen, the newly appointed Grand Guardian Wang Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, the newly appointed Grand Guardian Wang Hong died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，置積射、強弩將軍官。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiwei, he established the offices of General of Volley Fire and General of Strong Crossbows.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei, he established the offices of General of Volley Fire and General of Strong Crossbows.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以征西將軍、沙州刺史吐谷渾慕璝為征西大將軍、西秦河二州刺史、隴西王。

translations.literal: On yiwei he made the General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Shazhou Murong Mugui General Who Pacifies the West, Inspector of the two provinces of Western Qin and He, and King of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Murong Mugui, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Shazhou, was made General Who Pacifies the West, inspector of Western Qin and He provinces, and King of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以撫軍將軍江夏王義恭為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On renyin he made the General Who Pacifies the Army, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General Who Pacifies the North, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince Yigong of Jiangxia was made General Who Pacifies the North with privilege equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，以領軍將軍殷景仁為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, Yin Jingren, General of the Guard, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, General of the Guard Yin Jingren was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚寅，立皇子紹為廬陵王，奉孝獻王祀；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengyin, Prince Shao was established as Prince of Luling, to maintain the sacrifices of Prince Xiaoxian;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengyin, Prince Shao was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, charged with maintaining the ancestral rites of Prince Xiaoxian;

sentences.zh: 江夏王義恭子朗為南豐王，奉營陽王祀。

translations.literal: Lang, son of Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, as Prince of Nanfeng, to maintain the sacrifices of the Prince of Yingyang.
translations.idiomatic: and Lang, son of Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, as Prince of Nanfeng, charged with maintaining the rites of the Prince of Yingyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏延和元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Yanhe for Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Yanhe in Wei.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲寅，改封竟陵王義宣為南譙王。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, in the first month, on jiayin, the enfeoffment of Prince Yixuan of Jingling was changed to Prince of Nanqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year, on jiayin in the first month, Prince Yixuan of Jingling was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanqiao.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiwei, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 夏，林邑、闍婆娑州、訶羅單國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In summer, Linyi, Zhanpozhou, and Heluodan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, Linyi, Zhanpozhou, and Heluodan all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, a partial amnesty was granted for the three provinces of Yi, Liang, and Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, a partial amnesty was granted for Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，氐楊難當據有梁州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang seized Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang seized control of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，且渠蒙遜死。

translations.literal: That month, Juqu Mengxun died.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Juqu Mengxun died.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐，梁州平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the eleventh year, Xiao Sihua, Inspector of the two provinces of Liang and Qin, defeated the Di, and Liang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the eleventh year, Xiao Sihua, inspector of Liang and Qin, defeated the Di and restored order to Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣以北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingmao, a partial amnesty was granted north of Jian'ge in the two provinces of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingmao, a partial amnesty was granted for the region north of Jian'ge in Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以大且渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Juqu Maojian was made Grand General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Juqu Maojian was made Grand General Who Conquers the West and inspector of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑、扶南、訶羅單國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，大赦。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year, in the first month, on xinyou, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twelfth year, on xinyou in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, sacrifice was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the emperor performed the rites at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封馮弘為燕王。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Feng Hong was enfeoffed as King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Feng Hong was enfeoffed as King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰，詔內外舉士。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingchen, an edict ordered that scholars be recommended from within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingchen, an edict called for the recommendation of scholars from both within and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 都下地震。

translations.literal: The capital region was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck the capital region.

sentences.zh: 六月，禁酒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a prohibition on wine was imposed.

sentences.zh: 師子國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The Lion Kingdom sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Lion Kingdom sent a tribute mission to court.

sentences.zh: 丹陽、淮南、吳、吳興、義興大水，都下乘船。

translations.literal: Great floods struck Danyang, Huainan, Wu, Wuxing, and Yixing; in the capital people went by boat.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods inundated Danyang, Huainan, Wu, Wuxing, and Yixing, and in the capital people traveled by boat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米谷百萬斛，賜五郡遭水人。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a million hu of grain from the three provinces of Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan and the two commanderies of Kuaiji and Xuancheng was granted to the flood victims of the five commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou a million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and from Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies was distributed to flood victims in the five affected commanderies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，闍婆娑達、扶南國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, Zhanpozha and Funan both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, Zhanpozha and Funan both sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，原除遭水郡諸逋負。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yihai, all overdue obligations in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yihai, all unpaid taxes and levies in the flood-stricken commanderies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀賊張尋為寇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Shu bandit Zhang Xun raided.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Shu rebel Zhang Xun launched raids.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏太延元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Taiyan for Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Taiyan in Wei.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月癸丑朔，上有疾，不朝會。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year, on the first day of the first month, guichou, the emperor was ill and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirteenth year, on the new moon of the first month, guichou, the emperor was ill and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，誅司空江州刺史檀道濟。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jiangzhou, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiwei, Tan Daoji, Minister of Works and inspector of Jiangzhou, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦。

translations.literal: On gengshen, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，高麗、武都等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Goguryeo, Wudu, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, Goguryeo, Wudu, and other states all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，零陵王太妃殂，追崇為晉皇后，葬以晉禮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, the Princess Consort of the Prince of Lingling died; she was posthumously honored as Empress of Jin and buried according to Jin rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, the Princess Consort of the Prince of Lingling died; she was posthumously honored as Empress of Jin and buried with the rites of the Jin dynasty.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，立皇子浚為始興王、駿為武陵王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guichou, Prince Jun was established as Prince of Shixing, and Prince Jun as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guichou, Prince Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing and Prince Jun as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 是歲，馮弘奔高麗。

translations.literal: That year, Feng Hong fled to Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Feng Hong fled into Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛卯，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, in the first month, on xinmao, sacrifice was performed at the Southern Altar, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year, on xinmao in the first month, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鳳凰二見於都下，眾鳥隨之，改其地曰鳳凰裏。

translations.literal: On wuxu, two phoenixes appeared in the capital, and many birds followed them; the place was renamed Phoenix Lane.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu two phoenixes appeared in the capital, followed by a great flock of birds; the place was renamed Phoenix Lane.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，蜀賊張尋、趙廣降，遷之建鄴。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the Shu bandits Zhang Xun and Zhao Guang surrendered and were relocated to Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, the Shu rebels Zhang Xun and Zhao Guang surrendered and were resettled at Jianye.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，初停賀雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou, the snow-congratulation ceremony was suspended for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou, the court suspended the snow-congratulation ceremony for the first time.

sentences.zh: 河南、河西、訶羅單國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Henan, Hexi, and Heluodan all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Hexi, and Heluodan all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 十五年春二月，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史，封隴西王。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year, in the second month, Tuyuhun Muyan, General Who Pacifies the East, was made General Who Guards the West and Inspector of the two provinces of Qin and He, and enfeoffed as King of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifteenth year, in the second month, Tuyuhun Muyan, General Who Pacifies the East, was made General Who Guards the West, inspector of Qin and He provinces, and enfeoffed as King of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 新作東宮。

translations.literal: The Eastern Palace was newly built.
translations.idiomatic: A new Eastern Palace was constructed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都、河南、高麗、倭、扶南、林邑等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Wudu, Henan, Goguryeo, Wa, Funan, Linyi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Wudu, Henan, Goguryeo, Wa, Funan, Linyi, and other states all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 立儒學館於北郊，命雷次宗居之。

translations.literal: An Institute of Confucian Learning was established at the Northern Suburb, and Lei Cizong was appointed to preside over it.
translations.idiomatic: An Institute of Confucian Learning was established at the Northern Suburb, with Lei Cizong appointed to head it.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊寅，閱武於北郊。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, in the first month, on wuyin, troops were reviewed at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year, on wuyin in the first month, the emperor reviewed troops at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，進彭城王義康為大將軍、領司徒，以開府儀同三司江夏王義恭為司空。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Prince Yikang of Pengcheng was promoted to Grand General and concurrent Minister over the Masses; Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, who held an office equal to the Three Dukes, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince Yikang of Pengcheng was promoted to Grand General and concurrent Minister over the Masses, while Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, who held privilege equal to the Three Dukes, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏六月己酉，改封隴西王吐谷渾慕延為河南王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on jiyou, the enfeoffment of King Muyan of Longxi was changed to King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on jiyou, King Muyan of Longxi was re-enfeoffed as King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚子，立皇子鑠為南平王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi, Prince Shuo was established as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi, Prince Shuo was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 九月，魏滅且渠茂虔。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Wei destroyed Juqu Maojian.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wei destroyed Juqu Maojian.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai, the crown prince underwent the capping ceremony, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai, the crown prince underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都、河南、林邑、高麗等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Wudu, Henan, Linyi, Goguryeo, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Wudu, Henan, Linyi, Goguryeo, and other states all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 上好儒雅，又命丹陽尹何尚之立玄素學，著作佐郎何承天立史學，司徒參軍謝元立文學，各聚門徒，多就業者。

translations.literal: The emperor favored Confucian refinement; he also ordered He Shangzhi, Governor of Danyang, to establish the Studio of Mystic Simplicity, He Chengtian, Assistant in the Bureau of Authorship, to establish the Studio of History, and Xie Yuan, staff officer to the Minister over the Masses, to establish the Studio of Letters; each gathered disciples, and many came to study.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor favored Confucian refinement and ordered He Shangzhi, governor of Danyang, to establish the Studio of Mystic Simplicity, He Chengtian, assistant in the Bureau of Authorship, to establish the Studio of History, and Xie Yuan, staff officer to the Minister over the Masses, to establish the Studio of Letters; each gathered disciples, and many came to study under them.

sentences.zh: 江左風俗，於斯為美，後言政化，稱元嘉焉。

translations.literal: The customs east of the Yangtze at this time reached their finest; later ages, speaking of governance and transformation, called it the Yuanjia era.
translations.idiomatic: Customs east of the Yangtze reached their finest in this age; later generations, speaking of governance and culture, called it the Yuanjia era.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the seventeenth year, on the first day, wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the seventeenth year, on the new moon, wuwu, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，皇后袁氏崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, Empress Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, Empress Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，遣使振恤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the four provinces of Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji suffered great floods, and envoys were sent to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, great floods struck Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces, and the court sent envoys to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬元皇后于長寧陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi, Empress Yuan was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi, Empress Yuan was interred at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, the former Governor of Danyang Liu Zhan, found guilty, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, the former governor of Danyang Liu Zhan was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 大赦，文武賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were raised one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書事彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Prince Yikang of Pengcheng, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made Inspector of Jiangzhou; his rank as Grand General remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yikang of Pengcheng, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, and recorder of the Masters of Writing, was made inspector of Jiangzhou while retaining his rank as Grand General.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以司空江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses and recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十一月，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Inspector of Yangzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and inspector of Yangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guihai, Wang Qiu, Senior Grandee of Splendid Honors, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guihai, Senior Grandee Wang Qiu was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，武都、河南、百濟等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Wudu, Henan, Baekje, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wudu, Henan, Baekje, and other states all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏太平真君元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Taiping Zhenjun for Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Taiping Zhenjun in Wei.

sentences.zh: 十八年春三月庚子，雨雹。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year, in the third month, on gengzi, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighteenth year, on gengzi in the third month, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，置尚書刪定郎官。

translations.literal: On wushen, the office of Editorial Director in the Masters of Writing was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the office of Editorial Director in the Masters of Writing was established.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，衛將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, Prince Yiqing of Linchuan, General of the Guard and Inspector of Southern Yan, and Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and Inspector of Southern Xu, were both granted offices equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, Prince Yiqing of Linchuan, General of the Guard and inspector of Southern Yan, and Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, General Who Campaigns North and inspector of Southern Xu, were both granted privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 甲申，沔水泛溢，害居人。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the Han River overflowed and harmed the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Han River burst its banks and drowned many inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuchen, envoys were sent to tour the region and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, envoys were dispatched to tour the affected regions and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuzi, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on wuzi, Vice Director Wang Qiu died.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On jihai, Meng Yi, Governor of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Meng Yi, governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 氐楊難當寇漢川。

translations.literal: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang raided the Han River region.
translations.idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang raided the Han River basin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晉甯太守爨松子舉兵反，甯州刺史徐循討平之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Cuan Songzi, Governor of Jinning, raised troops in rebellion; Xu Xun, Inspector of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Cuan Songzi, governor of Jinning, raised troops in rebellion; Xu Xun, inspector of Ning Province, suppressed the revolt and restored order.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、肅特、高麗、蘇摩黎、林邑等國並遣使來朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Henan, Sute, Goguryeo, Sumoli, Linyi, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Henan, Sute, Goguryeo, Sumoli, Linyi, and other states all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 十九年夏四月甲戌，上以久疾愈，始奉初礿，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the nineteenth year, on jiaxu, the emperor, having recovered from a long illness, for the first time performed the spring solstice sacrifice, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the nineteenth year, on jiaxu, the emperor, recovered from a long illness, performed the spring ancestral sacrifice for the first time that year and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破楊難當，仇池平。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Liu Zhendao, Inspector of the two provinces of Liang and Qin, and Pei Fangming, General Who Quickens the Dragons, defeated Yang Nandang, and Chou Pool was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, Liu Zhendao, inspector of Liang and Qin, and Pei Fangming, General Who Quickens the Dragons, defeated Yang Nandang and pacified Chou Pool.

sentences.zh: 閏月，都下水，遣使巡行賑恤。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the capital was flooded, and envoys were sent to tour the region and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month the capital was inundated, and envoys were dispatched to tour the affected areas and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 六月，以大且渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Grand General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Juqu Wuhui was made Grand General Who Conquers the West, inspector of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the last day, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the last day, jiaxu, a solar eclipse occurred.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，有客星在北斗，因為彗，入文昌，貫五車，掃畢，拂天節，經天苑，季冬乃滅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen, a guest star appeared in the Northern Dipper, then became a comet; it entered Wenchang, passed through the Five Chariots, swept Bi, brushed Tianjie, crossed Tianyuan, and did not fade until late winter.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, a guest star appeared in the Northern Dipper and became a comet; it entered Wenchang, passed through the Five Chariots, swept Bi, brushed Tianjie, crossed Tianyuan, and did not fade until late winter.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月丙申，詔奉聖之胤，速議承襲；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on bingshen, an edict ordered that the descendants of the Sage quickly deliberate on succession;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on bingshen, an edict directed the descendants of the Sage to deliberate promptly on the succession;

sentences.zh: 及令修廟，四時饗祀；

translations.literal: and that temples be repaired with sacrifices offered in all four seasons;
translations.idiomatic: and ordered that their temples be repaired and sacrifices performed in all four seasons;

sentences.zh: 並命蠲近墓五家供灑掃，栽松柏六百株。

translations.literal: and it also commanded that five families near the tomb be exempted to supply sweeping and watering, and that six hundred pine and cypress trees be planted.
translations.idiomatic: It also exempted five families near the tomb from corvée so they could maintain the grounds, and ordered six hundred pine and cypress trees planted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、河南、扶南、婆皇國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Rouran, Henan, Funan, and Bahuang all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Rouran, Henan, Funan, and Bahuang all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 西涼武昭王孫李寶始歸於魏。

translations.literal: Li Bao, grandson of King Wuzhao of Western Liang, first submitted to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao, grandson of King Wuzhao of Western Liang, submitted to Wei for the first time.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月辛亥，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twentieth year, in the first month, on xinhai, sacrifice was performed at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twentieth year, on xinhai in the first month, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，閱武于白下。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiashen, troops were reviewed at Baixia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen, the emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.

sentences.zh: 魏軍克仇池。

translations.literal: The Wei army captured Chou Pool.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei army captured Chou Pool.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，立皇子誕為廣陵王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, Prince Dan was established as Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, Prince Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, Yang Wende was made Grand General Who Conquers the West and Inspector of Northern Qin Province, and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, Yang Wende was made Grand General Who Conquers the West, inspector of Northern Qin Province, and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，雷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, thunder sounded out of season.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，置藉田。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu, the ceremonial farming field was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, the ceremonial farming field was established.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西、高麗、百濟、倭國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Hexi, Goguryeo, Baekje, and Wa all sent tribute missions to court.

sentences.zh: 自去歲至是，諸州郡水旱傷稼。

translations.literal: From the previous year until this one, various provinces and commanderies suffered damage to the crops from flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: From the previous year through this one, floods and droughts damaged the harvests across many provinces and commanderies.

sentences.zh: 人大饑，遣使開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: The people suffered great famine, and envoys were sent to open the granaries and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people suffered severe famine, and the court opened the granaries and sent envoys to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南兗、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，並禁酒。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-first year, in the first month, on jihai, wine was prohibited in Southern Xu, Southern Yan, and Southern Yu provinces and in the region west of the Zhe River in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-first year, on jihai in the first month, wine was prohibited in Southern Xu, Southern Yan, and Southern Yu provinces and in the region west of the Zhe River in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，親耕藉田，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the emperor personally plowed the ceremonial field, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor personally plowed the ceremonial field and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jichou, Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, Minister over the Masses and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Commandant while retaining the post of Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, Minister over the Masses and recorder of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Commandant while retaining his post as Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立皇子宏為建平王。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Prince Hong was established as Prince of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Prince Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊辰，以荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuchen, the Inspector of Jingzhou, the Prince of Hengyang Yiji, was made Grand General of the North, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, Prince Yiji of Hengyang, inspector of Jingzhou, was appointed Grand General of the North with privilege equal to the Three Dukes and made inspector of Southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，以大且渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiachen, Juqu Anzhou was made General of the West and Inspector of Liangzhou, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen, Juqu Anzhou was made General of the West and inspector of Liangzhou, and enfeoffed as King of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，命刺史郡守修東耕。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, provincial inspectors and prefects were ordered to perform the eastern plowing rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jihai, provincial inspectors and prefects were ordered to perform the spring plowing ceremony in the east.

sentences.zh: 丙子，雷且電。

translations.literal: On bingzi there was thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi thunder and lightning were heard.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, on xinmao, the first day of the month, the Yuanjia New Calendar of the Censor-in-Chief He Chengtian was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the first month of the twenty-second year, the court adopted the Yuanjia New Calendar compiled by Censor-in-Chief He Chengtian.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，立皇子褘為東海王，昶為義陽王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiaxu, the imperial son Hui was installed as Prince of Donghai, and Chang as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, Prince Hui was made Prince of Donghai and Prince Chang Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為左僕射，中護軍何尚之為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, the Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Meng Yan was made Left Vice Director, and the General of the Guard He Shangzhi Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiwei, Meng Yan was promoted from Vice Director of the Masters of Writing to Left Vice Director, and He Shangzhi, General of the Guard, to Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，開酒禁。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiwei, the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiwei, the ban on wine was lifted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宴于武帳堂，上將行，敕諸子且勿食，至會所賜饌。

translations.literal: On guiyou he feasted at the Martial Canopy Hall; the sovereign was about to depart and ordered his sons not to eat yet, saying that food would be provided at the assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he held a feast at the Martial Canopy Hall. Before leaving, he told his sons not to eat yet—food would be served when they arrived.

sentences.zh: 日旰，食不至，有饑色。

translations.literal: When the sun had set, the food had not come, and they showed hunger on their faces.
translations.idiomatic: The sun had set, but no food arrived, and hunger showed on their faces.

sentences.zh: 上誡之曰：「汝曹少長豐佚，不見百姓艱難，今使爾識有饑苦，知以節儉期物。」

translations.literal: The sovereign admonished them, saying, "You have all grown up in plenty and ease, and have never seen the people's hardship. Now I make you know hunger and bitterness, so that you may understand thrift and measure your desires."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor admonished them: "You have grown up in comfort and never known the people's hardship. I want you to feel hunger, so you learn thrift and restraint."

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on yiwei, the Supervisor of the Heir Apparent Fan Ye plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, Fan Ye, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent, plotted rebellion; he and his co-conspirators were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人，絕屬籍。

translations.literal: On dingyou the Grand General, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, was removed and made a commoner; his name was struck from the imperial clan register.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Grand General Prince Yikang of Pengcheng was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status, and his name was erased from the imperial clan register.

sentences.zh: 是冬，浚淮，起湖熟廢田千餘頃。

translations.literal: That winter the Huai was dredged, and more than a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Huai River was dredged and more than a thousand qing of abandoned farmland at Hushu was brought back into cultivation.

sentences.zh: 二十三年夏四月丁未，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the twenty-third year, on dingwei, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-third year, on dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, guiwei, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the first day of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，克之。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Jiaozhou Tan Hezhi attacked the state of Linyi and conquered it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Hezhi, inspector of Jiaozhou, attacked the kingdom of Linyi and conquered it.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year there was a great harvest.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought an abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 築北堤，立玄武湖于樂游苑北，興景陽山于華林園，役重人怨。

translations.literal: The northern embankment was built; the Black Tortoise Lake was established north of the Leyou Park, and Jingyang Hill was raised in the Hualin Garden; the labor was heavy and the people resented it.
translations.idiomatic: A northern embankment was built, Black Tortoise Lake was created north of Leyou Park, and Jingyang Hill was raised in Hualin Garden; the corvée was heavy and provoked widespread resentment.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, on jiaxu, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, on jiaxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officials were raised one rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，河、濟俱清。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the Yellow River and the Ji River both ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Yellow River and the Ji River both ran clear.

sentences.zh: 六月，都下疫癘，使巡省給醫藥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month pestilence struck the capital; envoys were sent to tour and provide medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month plague struck the capital; officials were sent to inspect the sick and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 以貨貴，制大錢，一當兩。

translations.literal: Because goods were dear, large coin was instituted, one equal to two.
translations.idiomatic: Because prices were high, large coin was issued at a value of two standard coins.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未，徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on yiwei, the Inspector of Xuzhou, the Prince of Hengyang Yiji, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, Prince Yiji of Hengyang, inspector of Xuzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲寅，立皇子渾為汝陰王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiayin, the imperial son Hun was installed as Prince of Runan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, Prince Hun was made Prince of Runan.

sentences.zh: 是歲，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水。

translations.literal: That year Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces all suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces were all devastated by flooding.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春閏二月己酉，大搜于宣武場。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, in the intercalary second month, on jiyou, a great hunt was held at the Xuanwu Field.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the twenty-fifth year, on jiyou, a grand hunt was held at the Xuanwu Field.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，校獵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, troops were reviewed in the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen, a military hunt was held.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽門曰津陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming, and the Kaiyang gate was renamed Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yisi, new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the old Guangmo gate was renamed Chenming and the Kaiyang gate Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷當兩大錢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, the large coin equal to two was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the two-for-one large coin was abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu, the Prince of Lingling, Sima Yuanyu, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, Prince Yuanyu of Lingling died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，加荊州刺史南譙王義宣位司空。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Inspector of Jingzhou, the Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, inspector of Jingzhou, was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，立皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiazi, the imperial son Yu was installed as Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi, Prince Yu was made Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為左僕射。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinwei, the Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, He Shangzhi was promoted from Right to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬，青州城南遠望，見地中如水，有影，謂之「地鏡」。

translations.literal: In winter, south of Qingzhou city, looking from afar one saw the ground like water with a reflection in it; it was called the "earth mirror."
translations.idiomatic: In winter, south of Qingzhou city, distant observers saw the ground gleam like water with a reflection in it—a phenomenon called the "earth mirror."

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jihai, he traveled to Dantu and visited the imperial tombs there.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, he traveled to Dantu and visited the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，宴于丹徒宮，大赦；

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingsi, he feasted at the Dantu palace and proclaimed a great amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, he held a feast at the Dantu palace and proclaimed a general amnesty;

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半，行所經過，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: half of this year's rent and cloth for Dantu county and its displaced residents was restored; along the route he traveled, half the field rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: half of this year's rent and cloth tax was remitted for Dantu county and its displaced residents, and field rent was halved along the route of his journey.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌墓。

translations.literal: On guihai envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of the former Minister of Works of Jin, the Loyal and Solemn Duke He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, former Minister of Works of Jin and posthumously titled Loyal and Solemn Duke.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，至自丹徒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renwu, he returned from Dantu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, he returned from Dantu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu the state of Pohuang, and on renchen the state of Poda, both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the kingdom of Pohuang and on renchen the kingdom of Poda both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，改封廣陵王誕為隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, the Prince of Guangling Dan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suijun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengzi, Prince Dan of Guangling was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suijun.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，彗星見於太微。

translations.literal: On guimao a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao a comet appeared in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以揚州刺史始興王浚為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen the Inspector of Yangzhou, the Prince of Shixing Jun, was made Grand General of the North, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Prince Jun of Shixing, inspector of Yangzhou, was appointed Grand General of the North with privilege equal to the Three Dukes and made inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛卯，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinmao, the state of Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-seventh year, on xinmao, Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月，魏軍攻縣瓠。

translations.literal: In the second month, Wei forces attacked Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wei forces attacked Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 以軍興，減百官奉祿三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the military emergency, all officials' salaries were cut by one third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減奉祿，同內百官，於是諸州郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yichou, the Administrator of Huainan Zhuge Chan asked that his salary be reduced like those of the inner officials; thereupon the assistants, prefects, and county magistrates of all provinces and commanderies were all likewise reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, Zhuge Chan, administrator of Huainan, volunteered to cut his salary to match the court officials; thereafter assistants, prefects, and county magistrates throughout the realm followed suit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On wuyin the Imperial Academy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Imperial Academy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣甯朔將軍王玄謨拒魏，太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, the Pacifier of the North General Wang Xuanmo was sent to resist Wei; the Grand Commandant, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, went out and encamped at Pengcheng to command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengwu, Pacifier of the North Wang Xuanmo was sent to resist Wei, while Grand Commandant Prince Yigong of Jiangxia moved to Pengcheng to take overall command.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁未，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on dingwei, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，魏太武帝率大眾至瓜步，聲欲度江，都下震懼，咸荷擔而立。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, the Emperor of Wei, Taiwu, led a great host to Guabu, declaring that he would cross the river; the capital was shaken with fear, and all shouldered packs and stood ready.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Emperor Taiwu of Wei led a vast army to Guabu, threatening to cross the Yangtze; the capital was gripped with terror, and people stood ready with packs on their backs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴，緣江六七百里舳艫相接。

translations.literal: On renwu martial law was declared within and without; along the river for six or seven hundred li, boats and warships linked stem to stern.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu martial law was declared throughout the realm; for six or seven hundred li along the river, boats and warships lay stem to stern.

sentences.zh: 始議北侵，朝士多有不同，至是，帝登烽火樓極望，不悅，謂江湛曰：「北伐之計，同議者少，今日士庶勞怨，不得無慚。

translations.literal: When the northern campaign had first been debated, many court officials had disagreed; now the emperor ascended the beacon tower and looked to the farthest horizon, displeased, and said to Jiang Zhan, "Of those who agreed to the northern expedition, there were few. Today the gentry and common people labor and complain—I cannot but feel shame.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern campaign was first debated, many at court had opposed it. Now the emperor climbed the beacon tower and gazed to the horizon, displeased, and told Jiang Zhan, "Few agreed to this northern expedition. Now the people labor and complain—I cannot but feel ashamed.

sentences.zh: 貽大夫之憂，在予過矣。

translations.literal: That I have brought worry upon the great ministers is my fault alone.
translations.idiomatic: That I have brought this worry upon my ministers is my fault alone.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，使饋百牢于魏。

translations.literal: " On jiashen envoys were sent to present a hundred sets of sacrificial beasts to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiashen envoys were sent to present a hundred sets of sacrificial offerings to Wei.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丁亥，魏太武帝自瓜步退歸，俘廣陵居人萬餘家以北，徐、豫、青、冀、二兗六州殺略不可勝算，所過州郡，赤地無餘。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, on dinghai, the Emperor of Wei, Taiwu, withdrew from Guabu and returned north; he took captive more than ten thousand households of the people of Guangling and carried them northward.
