In Xu, Yu, Qing, Ji, and the two Yan provinces the killing and plunder were beyond counting; the provinces and commanderies he passed through were left bare ground without remainder.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-eighth year, on dinghai, Emperor Taiwu of Wei withdrew from Guabu and marched north, taking more than ten thousand households from Guangling as captives. In Xu, Yu, Qing, Ji, and the two Yan provinces the killing and looting were beyond reckoning; every region he passed through was left a wasteland.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，降太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiaxu, the Grand Commandant and concurrent Minister of Education, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was demoted to General of Agile Cavalry with an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, Grand Commandant Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, who also held the Ministry of Education, was demoted to General of Agile Cavalry with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸瓜步。

translations.literal: On renwu he traveled to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he traveled to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 是日，解嚴。

translations.literal: That day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiyou, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，拜初寧陵。

translations.literal: On bingshen he paid visit to Chuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he visited Chuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 大旱。

translations.literal: A great drought.
translations.idiomatic: A severe drought struck.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guiyou, the state of Poda sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiyou, the kingdom of Poda sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，彗星見於昴。

translations.literal: On jimao a comet appeared in the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a comet appeared in the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 是月，都下疾疫，使巡省給醫藥。

translations.literal: That month pestilence struck the capital; envoys were sent to tour and provide medicine.
translations.idiomatic: That month plague struck the capital; officials were sent to inspect the sick and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiyou, the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingsi the state of Pohuang, and on wuxu the state of Henan, both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the kingdom of Pohuang and on wuxu the kingdom of Henan both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為左僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wushen the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Shangzhi was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and the Supervisor of the Heir Apparent Xu Zhanzhi was made Left Vice Director and General of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen He Shangzhi was promoted from Left Vice Director to Director of the Masters of Writing, and Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent, was made Left Vice Director and General of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬子，彗星見太微中，對帝坐。

translations.literal: On renzi a comet appeared within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, facing the emperor's seat.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi a comet appeared within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, directly facing the emperor's throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，進安東將軍倭王綏濟為安東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, the Pacifier of the East General, the King of Wa Suiko, was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiachen, Suiko, King of Wa and Pacifier of the East, was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, Liangzou was retaken and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 是秋，猛獸入郭內為災。

translations.literal: That autumn fierce beasts entered within the outer walls and caused disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn wild beasts entered the city and caused havoc.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guihai, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州，徙彭城流人于瓜步，淮西流人于姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji; displaced persons from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu, and those from west of the Huai to Gushu, totaling about ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, a partial amnesty was granted in the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji; refugees from Pengcheng were resettled at Guabu and those from west of the Huai at Gushu, about ten thousand households in all.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏正平元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Zhengping of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first Zhengping year of Wei.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔經寇六州，仍逢災澇，可量加救贍。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu, an edict was issued: the six provinces that had suffered invasion and also met with flood disaster might receive relief and sustenance according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu, an edict ordered measured relief for the six provinces that had suffered both invasion and flooding.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，雷且雪。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, there was thunder and snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, thunder and snow were seen together.

sentences.zh: 戊午，立皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On wuwu the imperial son Xiuren was installed as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Prince Xiuren was made Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，大風拔木，都下火。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renwu, a great wind uprooted trees, and fire broke out in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu, a violent wind uprooted trees and fire broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, the state of Heluodan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuwu, the kingdom of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，改封汝陰王渾為武昌王，淮陽王彧為湘東王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, the Prince of Runan Hun was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang, and the Prince of Huaiyang Yu as Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renchen, Prince Hun of Runan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang and Prince Yu of Huaiyang as Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On dingyou the offices of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the posts of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史，封河南王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, the Pacifier of the West General Tuyuhun Shibin was made Pacifier of the West General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces, and enfeoffed as King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Shibin of Tuyuhun was made Pacifier of the West and inspector of Qin and He provinces, and enfeoffed as King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on renyin, the Inspector of Yangzhou, the Prince of Luling Shao, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Prince Shao of Luling, inspector of Yangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，黃霧四塞。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, yellow mist filled the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, yellow mist filled the sky on every side.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書如故。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Inspector of Southern Yanzhou, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was made Grand General and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, continuing as before as Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince Yigong of Jiangxia, inspector of Southern Yanzhou, was made Grand General and inspector of Southern Xuzhou while retaining his post as Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏中常侍宗愛構逆，太武皇帝崩，乃奉南安王餘為帝，改元為承平，後又賊餘；

translations.literal: That year the Palace Attendant of Wei Zong Ai plotted treason; the Emperor Taiwu died, and he then installed the Prince of Nan'an Yu as emperor and changed the era name to Chengping; afterward he murdered Yu as well;
translations.idiomatic: That year Palace Attendant Zong Ai of Wei plotted treason; Emperor Taiwu died, and Zong Ai installed Prince Yu of Nan'an as emperor under the era name Chengping, then murdered him as well;

sentences.zh: 於是殿中尚書長孫渴侯、尚書陸麗奉皇孫，是為文成皇帝，改元曰興安。

translations.literal: thereupon the Palace Secretary Changsun Kehou and the Master of Writing Lu Li installed the imperial grandson, who is known as Emperor Wencheng, and changed the era name to Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: whereupon Palace Secretary Changsun Kehou and Master of Writing Lu Li installed the imperial grandson, known as Emperor Wencheng, and changed the era name to Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月乙亥朔，會群臣於太極前殿，有青黑氣從東南來，覆映宮上。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on yihai, the first day of the month, he assembled the ministers before the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; a green-black vapor came from the southeast and spread over the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the first day of the first month of the thirtieth year, he assembled his ministers in the Hall of the Supreme Ultimate; a green-black vapor rolled in from the southeast and spread over the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin the Minister of Works and Inspector of Jingzhou, the Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, was made Minister of Education, General of the Center, and Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, Minister of Works and inspector of Jingzhou, was made Minister of Education, General of the Center, and inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以南徐州刺史始興王浚為衛將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On renwu the Inspector of Southern Xuzhou, the Prince of Shixing Jun, was made General of the Guard, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Prince Jun of Shixing, inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was appointed General of the Guard with privilege equal to the Three Dukes and made inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，使江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On wuzi he ordered the Inspector of Jiangzhou, the Prince of Wuling Jun, to command the host of armies in attacking the Western Yang barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he ordered Prince Jun of Wuling, inspector of Jiangzhou, to lead the armies against the Western Yang tribes.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，元凶劭構逆，帝崩於合殿，時年四十七。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiazi, the crown prince Liu Shao plotted treason; the emperor died in the Hall of Union, aged forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi, Crown Prince Liu Shao plotted treason; the emperor died in the Hall of Union at the age of forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 諡景皇帝，廟號中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing, and his temple name Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Emperor Jing, with temple name Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guisi, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝踐阼，追改諡曰文帝，廟號太祖。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu ascended the throne, he changed the posthumous title to Emperor Wen and the temple name to Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, he changed the posthumous title to Emperor Wen and the temple name to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 帝聰明仁厚，雅重文儒，躬勤政事，孜孜無怠，加以在位日久，惟簡靖為心。

translations.literal: The emperor was intelligent, benevolent, and generous; he honored literati and Confucians, personally attended to government affairs with tireless diligence; moreover, having reigned for a long time, he kept simplicity and quiet as his heart's aim.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was intelligent, benevolent, and magnanimous; he honored scholars and Confucians, attended personally to affairs of state without slackening, and over his long reign kept simplicity and restraint at the center of his rule.

sentences.zh: 于時政平訟理，朝野悅睦，自江左之政，所未有也。

translations.literal: At that time government was peaceful and lawsuits were settled; court and countryside were harmonious and content—such a reign as the lands south of the Yangtze had never known.
translations.idiomatic: Government was peaceful and justice was done; court and countryside lived in harmony—a level of order the lands south of the Yangtze had never before known.

sentences.zh: 又性存儉約，不好奢侈。

translations.literal: Moreover by nature he kept thrift and restraint, and did not care for luxury.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was thrifty and abstemious, with no taste for luxury.

sentences.zh: 車府令嘗以輦莑故，請改易之；

translations.literal: The Director of the Chariot Office once because the palanquin canopy was aged requested to replace it;
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Chariot Office once asked to replace the imperial palanquin canopy, citing its worn condition;

sentences.zh: 又輦席舊以烏皮緣故，欲代以紫皮，上以竹莑未至於壞，紫色貴，並不聽改。

translations.literal: Again the palanquin matting, because the old one had black-leather borders, they wished to replace with purple leather; the sovereign because the bamboo matting had not yet reached ruin, and purple was costly, would not consent to either change.
translations.idiomatic: They also wanted to replace the black-leather edging on the palanquin matting with purple leather; the emperor refused both requests—the bamboo matting was still serviceable, and purple was too costly.

sentences.zh: 其率素如此云。

translations.literal: Such was his plain simplicity, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his plainness and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 世祖孝武皇帝，諱駿，字休龍，小字道人，文帝第三子也。

translations.literal: Shizu Emperor Xiaowu, taboo name Jun, style name Xiulong, childhood name Daoren, was the third son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu, Emperor Xiaowu, personal name Jun, courtesy name Xiulong, childhood name Daoren, was the third son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 元嘉七年八月庚午夜生，有光照室。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanjia, on the night of gengwu in the eighth month, he was born; there was light filling the room.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on gengwu night in the eighth month of the seventh Yuanjia year; light filled the room.

sentences.zh: 少機穎，神明爽發，讀書七行俱下，才藻甚美，雄決愛武，長於騎射。

translations.literal: In youth he was quick-witted, with bright and penetrating spirit; in reading he took in seven lines at once; his literary talent was very fine; bold and resolute, he loved warfare; skilled in horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he was quick-witted and sharp-minded, reading seven lines at a glance; his literary gifts were fine, his temperament bold and martial; he excelled at horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 十二年，立為武陵王，二十二年，累遷雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was installed as Prince of Wuling; in the twenty-second year he was promoted in stages to Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Prince of Wuling; by the twenty-second year he had risen to inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 自晉江左以來，襄陽未有皇子重鎮，時文帝欲經略關、河，故有此授。

translations.literal: Since the Eastern Jin south of the Yangtze, Xiangyang had never had a prince as garrison commander; at that time Emperor Wen wished to advance strategy toward Guan and He, and therefore made this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Jin moved south, no imperial prince had ever been posted to Xiangyang; Emperor Wen intended to advance toward the passes and the Yellow River, and so gave him the command.

sentences.zh: 及魏太武大舉至淮南，時帝鎮彭城，魏使尚書李孝伯至，帝遣長史張暢與語，而帝改服觀之。

translations.literal: When the Wei Emperor Taiwu launched a major campaign to Huainan, at that time the prince was garrisoning Pengcheng; the Wei sent Master of Writing Li Xiaobo; the prince sent Chief Administrator Zhang Chang to speak with him, while the prince changed dress to observe.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wei Emperor Taiwu marched in force to Huainan, the prince was garrisoned at Pengcheng. The Wei sent Li Xiaobo, Master of Writing; he dispatched Chief Administrator Zhang Chang to parley while he changed clothes to watch unnoticed.

sentences.zh: 孝伯目帝不輟，及出，謂人曰：「張侯側有人風骨視瞻，非常士也。

translations.literal: Xiaobo's gaze on the prince never ceased; when he departed he said to others, "Beside Marquis Zhang is a man of extraordinary bearing in look and carriage—not an ordinary man.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaobo never stopped staring at the prince. When he left he said to others, "Beside Marquis Zhang stands a man of extraordinary bearing—not an ordinary sort at all."

sentences.zh: 」二十八年，為都督、江州刺史。

translations.literal: " In the twenty-eighth year he became Area Commander and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twenty-eighth year he was made area commander and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 時緣江蠻為寇，文帝遣太子步兵校尉沈慶之等伐之，使上總統眾軍。

translations.literal: At that time the river-bank Man raided; Emperor Wen dispatched the Heir Apparent's Colonel of Footsoldiers Shen Qingzhi and others to attack them, and made the prince supreme commander of the host of armies.
translations.idiomatic: When river-bank tribal raiders struck, Emperor Wen sent Shen Qingzhi, Colonel of Footsoldiers to the Heir Apparent, and others against them, placing the prince in supreme command.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，出次西陽之五洲，會元凶弑逆，上率眾入討。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, first month, he went out and encamped at Wuzhou in Xiyang; it happened that the crown prince committed regicide and treason; the prince led the host inward to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, first month, he encamped at Wuzhou in Xiyang; when the crown prince committed regicide, he led his army to march on the capital.

sentences.zh: 荊州刺史南譙王義宣、雍州刺史臧質並舉義兵。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, and the Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi both raised righteous armies.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, inspector of Jingzhou, and Zang Zhi, inspector of Yongzhou, both raised armies in the cause.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，建牙於軍門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiwei, he raised the command standard at the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiwei, he raised the command standard before the army.

sentences.zh: 是時多不悉舊儀，有一翁斑白，自稱少從武帝征伐，頗悉其事，因使指麾，事畢，忽失所在。

translations.literal: At that time many did not know the old ceremonies; there was an old man, hair streaked white, who called himself once in youth having followed Emperor Wu on campaigns and knowing those matters well; accordingly he was made to direct; when matters were finished, he suddenly vanished from sight.
translations.idiomatic: Many no longer knew the old military rituals. A white-haired old man appeared, claiming to have campaigned under Emperor Wu and to know the rites; he was put in charge, and when the ceremony ended, vanished without trace.

sentences.zh: 自冬至春，常東北風，連陰不霽，其日牙立之後，風轉而西南，景色開霽，有紫雲二蔭於牙上。

translations.literal: From winter to spring northeast wind had constantly blown, with unbroken cloud and no clearing; on the day after the standard was raised, the wind turned southwest, the sky cleared, and two purple clouds shaded the standard.
translations.idiomatic: From winter through spring northeast winds had brought unbroken gloom; after the standard was raised the wind swung southwest, the sky cleared, and two purple clouds hung over the command pole.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，上次溧洲。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on xinyou, the prince advanced and halted at Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on xinyou, he advanced to Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次江寧。

translations.literal: On bingyin he halted at Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he encamped at Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大將軍江夏王義恭來奔，奉表上尊號。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, came fleeing to join him, presenting a memorial offering the exalted title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Grand General Prince Yigong of Jiangxia fled to his camp and presented a memorial offering the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上至新亭。

translations.literal: On wuchen the prince reached Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he reached Xinting.

sentences.zh: 己巳，即皇帝位，大赦，改文帝號諡。

translations.literal: On jisi he immediately took the imperial throne, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed Emperor Wen's posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he took the throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and revised Emperor Wen's posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍江夏王義恭為太尉、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: He made the Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Commandant and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Grand General Prince Yigong of Jiangxia Grand Commandant and inspector of Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以荊州刺史南譙王義宣為中書監、丞相、揚州刺史，並錄尚書六條事。

translations.literal: On gengwu he made the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, Chancellor, and Inspector of Yangzhou, and concurrently Recorder of the Six Sections of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he made Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao, inspector of Jingzhou, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, chancellor, and inspector of Yangzhou, with concurrent charge over the Six Sections of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 以安東將軍隨王誕為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: He made the General Who Pacifies the East, Prince of Sui Yan, General of the Guard and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He made Prince Yan of Sui, General Who Pacifies the East, General of the Guard and inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 加雍州刺史臧質車騎將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: He promoted the Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Zang Zhi from inspector of Yongzhou to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and inspector of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: All were granted offices equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: All were granted offices with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: The General Who Pacifies the Armies Xiao Sihua was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sihua, General Who Pacifies the Armies, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以征虜將軍王僧達為右僕射。

translations.literal: On renshen he made the General Who Repels Barbarians Wang Sengda Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he made Wang Sengda, General Who Repels Barbarians, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 改新亭為中興亭。

translations.literal: Xinting was renamed Zhongxing Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Xinting was renamed Zhongxing Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙亥，輔國將軍朱修之克東府。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on yihai, the General Who Assists the State Zhu Xiuzhi captured the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yihai, Zhu Xiuzhi, General Who Assists the State, captured the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，克建鄴，二凶及同逆並伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingzi he captured Jiankang; the two villains and all fellow rebels were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Jiankang fell; the crown prince and his chief accomplice, and all fellow rebels, were executed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔分遣大使巡省方俗。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict ordered separate dispatch of grand envoys to tour and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict dispatched grand envoys to tour the provinces and report on local customs.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴。

translations.literal: That day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸東府城。

translations.literal: On xinsi the sovereign visited the Eastern Palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he visited the Eastern Palace quarter.

sentences.zh: 甲申，尊所生路淑媛為皇太后。

translations.literal: On jiashen he honored his birth mother, Lady Lu Shuyuan, as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he honored his birth mother, Lady Lu Shuyuan, as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On yiyou he installed Consort Wang as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he installed Consort Wang as empress.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以太尉江夏王義恭為太傅，領大司馬。

translations.literal: On renchen he made the Grand Commandant, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Grand Tutor, concurrently holding Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he made Grand Commandant Prince Yigong of Jiangxia Grand Tutor, concurrent Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 甲午，謁初甯陵，曲赦建鄴二百里內，並蠲今年租稅。

translations.literal: On jiawu he paid visit to Chuning Mausoleum; a partial amnesty was granted within two hundred li of Jiankang, and this year's land tax and levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he visited Chuning Mausoleum; a partial amnesty was granted within two hundred li of Jiankang, and land taxes for the year were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以撫軍將軍南平王鑠為司空，建平王宏為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu he made the General Who Pacifies the Armies, Prince of Nanping Shuo, Minister of Works, and Prince of Jianping Hong Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he made Prince Shuo of Nanping, General Who Pacifies the Armies, Minister of Works, and Prince Hong of Jianping Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 初置殿門及上合門屯兵。

translations.literal: For the first time garrison troops were established at the palace gates and the Upper Gate of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops were first posted at the palace gates and the Upper Gate of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以丹陽尹褚湛之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On gengwu he made the Administrator of Danyang Chu Zhanzhi Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he made Chu Zhanzhi, administrator of Danyang, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔有司論功班賞各有差。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict ordered the responsible offices to assess merit and distribute rewards, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict ordered officials to assess merit and distribute rewards by rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，安西將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號鎮西大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On xinyou the General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Western Qin and He provinces Tuyuhun Shibin was promoted in title to Grand General Who Guards the West, with an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Tuyuhun Shibin, General Who Pacifies the West and inspector of Western Qin and He provinces, was promoted to Grand General Who Guards the West with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改封南譙王義宣為南郡王，隨王誕為竟陵王。

translations.literal: On xinwei he changed the enfeoffment of Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan to Prince of Nanjun, and Prince of Sui Yan to Prince of Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince Yixuan of Nanqiao was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanjun, and Prince Yan of Sui as Prince of Jingling.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙子，遣兼散騎常侍樂詢等十五人巡行風俗。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingzi, he dispatched the Acting Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Yue Xun and fifteen others to tour and observe customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingzi, he sent fifteen envoys led by Yue Xun, Acting Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, to tour the realm and report on local customs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，加太傅江夏王義恭錄尚書事，以荊州刺史竟陵王誕為侍中、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengshen he added to Grand Tutor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong the Recorder of the Masters of Writing; he made the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Jingling Yan, Palace Attendant, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Grand Tutor Prince Yigong of Jiangxia was given charge as Recorder of the Masters of Writing; Prince Yan of Jingling, inspector of Jingzhou, was made palace attendant, Grand General of Agile Cavalry with privilege equal to the Three Dukes, and inspector of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蠲尋陽、西陽郡租布三年。

translations.literal: On jiashen land tax and cloth levies of Xunyang and Xiyang commanderies were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen land tax and cloth levies for Xunyang and Xiyang commanderies were remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 是月，置衛尉官。

translations.literal: That month the office of Commandant of the Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: That month the office of Commandant of the Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the new moon of the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔崇儉約，禁淫侈。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict promoted thrift and restraint and forbade excess and luxury.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict enjoined frugality and forbade extravagant spending.

sentences.zh: 己巳，司空南平王鑠薨，以侍中南郡王世子恢為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On jisi the Minister of Works, Prince of Nanping Shuo, died; the Palace Attendant and Heir of Prince of Nanjun Hui was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Prince Shuo of Nanping, Minister of Works, died; Hui, heir of Prince of Nanjun and palace attendant, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，聽訟于閱武堂。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei, he heard lawsuits at the Hall for Reviewing the Military.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiwei, he heard lawsuits at the Hall for Reviewing the Military.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，停台省眾官朔望問訊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, the monthly new-moon and full-moon inquiries of all capital officials were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingchen, the monthly new- and full-moon greetings of capital officials were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingyin the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，省都水使者官，置水衡令官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, the office of Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways was abolished and the office of Director of Waterways established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, the office of Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways was abolished and replaced with a Director of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以將置東宮，省太子率更令、步兵、翊軍校尉、旅賁中郎將、冗從僕射、左右積弩將軍官。

translations.literal: On guiwei, because the Eastern Palace was about to be established, the offices of Director of Palace Discipline to the Heir Apparent, Colonels of Footsoldiers, Adjutant Horsemen, Captain of the Travelling Guard, Supernumerary Attendant, and Left and Right Crossbow Generals were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, in preparation for establishing the eastern palace, numerous offices of the heir apparent's household were abolished.

sentences.zh: 中庶子、中舍人、庶子、舍人、洗馬各減舊員之半。

translations.literal: Palace Preceptors, Central Gentlemen-Attendants, Preceptors, Gentlemen-Attendants, and Palace Guards each had their old complement reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Palace preceptors, attendants, stewards, and guards each had their staffs cut by half.

sentences.zh: 孝建元年春正月己亥朔，祀南郊，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Xiaojian, on jihai, the first day of the month, he sacrificed at the southern suburb, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the new year of the first Xiaojian year, he sacrificed at the southern suburb, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，更鑄四銖錢。

translations.literal: On renxu the four-zhu coin was recast.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu new four-zhu coins were minted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立皇子子業為皇太子，賜天下為父後者爵一級。

translations.literal: On bingyin the imperial son Ziye was installed as crown prince; all who were heirs to their fathers throughout the realm were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Prince Ziye was installed as crown prince; every lawful eldest son in the realm was granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 是月，起正光殿。

translations.literal: That month construction began on the Zhengguang Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That month construction began on the Hall of True Radiance.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，豫州刺史魯爽，車騎將軍、江州刺史臧質，丞相、荊州刺史南郡王義宣，兗州刺史徐遺寶舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengwu, the Inspector of Yuzhou Lu Shuang, the Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiangzhou Zang Zhi, the Chancellor and Inspector of Jingzhou Prince of Nanjun Yixuan, and the Inspector of Yanzhou Xu Yibao all raised armies in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, Lu Shuang, inspector of Yuzhou; Zang Zhi, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and inspector of Jiangzhou; Prince Yixuan of Nanjun, chancellor and inspector of Jingzhou; and Xu Yibao, inspector of Yanzhou, all rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 壬午，曲赦豫州。

translations.literal: On renwu a partial amnesty was granted in Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a partial amnesty was granted in Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jihai, martial law was declared within and without.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jihai, martial law was declared at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲寅，義宣等攻梁山，左衛將軍王玄謨大破之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on jiayin, Yixuan and the others attacked Liangshan; the Left Guard General Wang Xuanmo routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, Yixuan and the rebels attacked Liangshan and were routed by Wang Xuanmo, Left Guard General.

sentences.zh: 己未，解嚴。

translations.literal: On jiwei martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以吳興太守劉延孫為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On guihai he made the Administrator of Wuxing Liu Yansun Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he made Liu Yansun, administrator of Wuxing, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，臧質走至武昌，為人所斬，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuchen, Zang Zhi fled as far as Wuchang, was beheaded by someone, and his head was sent to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, Zang Zhi fled to Wuchang, where he was killed; his head was sent to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，撫軍將軍柳元景進號撫軍大將軍，及鎮北大將軍沈慶之並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the General Who Pacifies the Armies Liu Yuanjing was promoted in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the Armies, and the Grand General of the North Shen Qingzhi both received offices equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Liu Yuanjing was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the Armies, and Shen Qingzhi, Grand General of the North, was also granted an office with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷南蠻校尉官。

translations.literal: On guiwei the office of Colonel of the Southern Man was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the office of Colonel of the Southern Man was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，省錄尚書官。

translations.literal: On wuzi the office of Recorder of the Masters of Writing was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the office of Recorder of the Masters of Writing was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，義宣於江陵賜死。

translations.literal: On gengyin Yixuan was granted death at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yixuan was ordered to take his own life at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，日有蝕之，既。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingshen, the first day of the month, there was a total solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the new moon of the seventh month, there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大赦，賜文武爵一級。

translations.literal: On bingchen a great amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen a general amnesty was proclaimed and all civil and military officials received one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，詔開建仲尼廟，制同諸侯之禮，詳擇爽塏，厚給祭秩。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, an edict ordered construction of a temple to Confucius, with rites equal to those of feudal lords, carefully selecting a bright open site and granting generous sacrificial stipends.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin, an edict ordered a temple built to Confucius with rites equal to those of a feudal lord, on a chosen auspicious site with generous sacrificial stipends.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，復置都水使者官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao, the office of Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, the office of Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways was restored.

sentences.zh: 始課南徐州僑人租。

translations.literal: For the first time land tax was levied on émigré households in Southern Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Land tax was first levied on refugee households registered in Southern Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏興光元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Xingguang of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year corresponded to the first year of Xingguang under the Wei.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月己丑，婆皇國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year, on jichou, the state of Bohuang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, the kingdom of Bohuang sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以南兗州刺史沈慶之為左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On bingyin he made the Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Shen Qingzhi Left Grandee of Splendid Honors, with an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he made Shen Qingzhi, inspector of Southern Yanzhou, Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，河南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen, the state of Henan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on renshen, the kingdom of Henan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，熒惑入南斗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yiwei, Mars entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiwei, Mars entered the constellation of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以湘州刺史劉遵考為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu he made the Inspector of Xiangzhou Liu Zunkao Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he made Liu Zunkao, inspector of Xiangzhou, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，以國哀除釋，大赦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiazi, because the period of national mourning had ended, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiazi, with the end of the mourning period, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，立皇弟休佑為山陽王、休茂為海陵王、休業為鄱陽王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi, the imperial younger brother Xiuyou was installed as Prince of Shanyang, Xiumao as Prince of Hailing, and Xiuye as Prince of Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on guisi, his brothers Xiuyou, Xiumao, and Xiuye were enfeoffed as princes of Shanyang, Hailing, and Poyang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，盤盤國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiyou the state of Panpan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the kingdom of Panpan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，雍州刺史武昌王渾有罪，廢為庶人，自殺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen, the Inspector of Yongzhou, Prince of Wuchang Hun, was guilty, degraded to commoner, and committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Prince Hun of Wuchang, inspector of Yongzhou, was found guilty, stripped of rank, and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幹陀利國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinyou the state of Gandhara sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the kingdom of Gandhara sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 三吳饑，詔所在振貸。

translations.literal: The Three Wu regions suffered famine; an edict ordered localities to provide relief grain and loans.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck the Three Wu region; an edict ordered local officials to distribute relief grain.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，閱武于宣武場。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, he reviewed the troops at the Xuanwu Field.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, he reviewed troops at the Field of Martial Display.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，以揚州刺史竟陵王誕為司空、南徐州刺史，以尚書左僕射建平王宏為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu, the Inspector of Yangzhou, Prince of Jingling Yan, was made Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Xuzhou; the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jianping Hong, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renwu, Prince Yan of Jingling, inspector of Yangzhou, was made Minister of Works and inspector of Southern Xuzhou, and Prince Hong of Jianping was promoted from Left Vice Director to Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinhai, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏太安元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Taian of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year corresponded to the first year of Taian under the Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚寅，立皇弟休范為順陽郡王，休若為巴陵郡王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on gengyin, the imperial younger brother Xiufan was installed as Prince of Shunyang commandery, and Xiuruo as Prince of Baling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on gengyin, his brothers Xiufan and Xiuruo were enfeoffed as princes of Shunyang and Baling commanderies.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，立皇子子尚為西陽郡王。

translations.literal: On wuxu the imperial son Zishang was installed as Prince of Xiyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince Zishang was enfeoffed as prince of Xiyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎將軍建昌忠公到彥之，衛將軍、左光祿大夫新建文宣侯王華，豫甯文侯王曇首配饗文帝廟庭。

translations.literal: The Grand General of Agile Cavalry, the Loyal Duke of Jianchang Dao Yanzhi; the General of the Guard and Left Grandee of Splendid Honors, the Literary Marquis of Xinjian Wang Hua; and the Literary Marquis of Yuning Wang Tanshou were given associate seats in Emperor Wen's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Yanzhi, Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Loyal Duke of Jianchang; Wang Hua, General of the Guard, Left Grandee of Splendid Honors, and Literary Marquis of Xinjian; and Wang Tanshou, Literary Marquis of Yuning, were given places in the sacrifices at Emperor Wen's temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇太子納妃。

translations.literal: On renzi the crown prince received a consort in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the crown prince took a bride.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiayin a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 群臣上禮。

translations.literal: The host of ministers presented congratulatory gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The court officials presented congratulatory gifts.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，制朔望臨西堂，接群下，受奏事。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingchou, a rule was set that on new moon and full moon days he should attend the Western Hall, receive the host of subordinates, and accept memorial reports.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingchou, a rule was established that on each new and full moon he would attend the Western Hall to receive officials and hear memorials.

sentences.zh: 閏三月癸酉，鄱陽王休業薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month, on guiyou, Prince of Poyang Xiuye died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on guiyou, Prince Xiuye of Poyang died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，初禁人車及酒肆器用銅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi, for the first time copper was forbidden in private carriages and tavern vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiazi, the use of copper in private carriages and tavern vessels was first forbidden.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，制荊、徐、兗、豫、雍、青、冀七州統內，家有馬一匹者，蠲復一丁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinyou, a rule was set that within Jing, Xu, Yan, Yu, Yong, Qing, and Ji—the seven provinces—a household owning one horse was exempt one adult male's labor service.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinyou, a rule granted labor-service exemption for one adult male in any household in the seven northern provinces that owned a horse.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬戌，以丹陽尹劉遵考為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, on renxu, the Administrator of Danyang Liu Zunkao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, Liu Zunkao, administrator of Danyang, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，太傅江夏王義恭進位太宰，領司徒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu, the Grand Tutor, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was advanced to Grand Preceptor, concurrently holding Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingwu, Grand Tutor Prince Yigong of Jiangxia was promoted to Grand Preceptor, concurrent Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 大明元年春正月辛亥朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Daming, on xinhai, the first day of the month, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the new year of the first Daming year, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，都下雨水。

translations.literal: On gengwu rain fell throughout the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu rain fell on the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使檢行，賜以樵米。

translations.literal: On xinwei envoys were dispatched to inspect; firewood and grain were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei officials were sent to inspect the damage and distribute firewood and grain.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，制大臣加班劍者不得入宮城門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renxu, a rule was set that great ministers bearing the ceremonial sword of office might not enter the palace-city gates.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu, a rule forbade ministers bearing ceremonial swords of office to enter the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，都下疾疫。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, pestilence struck the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month plague broke out in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣使巡，賜給醫藥；

translations.literal: On bingshen envoys were dispatched to tour; medicine was granted and distributed;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen envoys were sent to inspect the sick and supply medicine;

sentences.zh: 死而無收斂者，官為斂埋。

translations.literal: those who died and had none to bury them—the government would bury them.
translations.idiomatic: the state would bury those who died with no one to arrange funeral rites.

sentences.zh: 五月，吳興、義興大水，人饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wuxing and Yixing suffered great floods; the people went hungry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month floods devastated Wuxing and Yixing, and the people faced starvation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On yimao envoys were dispatched to open granaries and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao officials were sent to open granaries and provide famine relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，聽訟于華林園。

translations.literal: On guiyou he heard lawsuits in the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he heard lawsuits in the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 自是，非巡狩軍役，則車駕歲三臨訊。

translations.literal: From this time, unless on inspection tours or military campaigns, the imperial carriage three times each year attended judicial sessions.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, except during tours or campaigns, the emperor held three judicial sessions each year.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，芳香琴堂東西有雙橘連理，景陽樓上層西南梁栱間有紫氣，清暑殿西甍鴟尾中央生嘉禾，一株五莖。

translations.literal: On bingyin at the Fragrant Qin Hall east and west there were paired orange trees joined in one trunk; on the upper story of the Jingyang Tower between the southwest beam-brackets there was purple vapor; on the west roof-ridge finial at the center of the Clear Summer Hall grew an auspicious grain stalk with five stems from one plant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin paired orange trees grew joined in one trunk beside the Fragrant Qin Hall; purple vapor appeared among the southwest beam-brackets of the Jingyang Tower; and an auspicious grain stalk of five stems sprouted from the west finial of the Clear Summer Hall.

sentences.zh: 改景陽樓為慶雲樓，清暑殿為嘉禾殿，芳香琴堂為連理堂。

translations.literal: The Jingyang Tower was renamed Tower of Auspicious Clouds; the Clear Summer Hall was renamed Hall of Auspicious Grain; the Fragrant Qin Hall was renamed Hall of Joined Trunks.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyang Tower was renamed Tower of Auspicious Clouds, the Clear Summer Hall Hall of Auspicious Grain, and the Fragrant Qin Hall Hall of Joined Trunks.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以輔國將軍梁瑾蔥為河州刺史，封宕昌王。

translations.literal: On yihai he made the General Who Assists the State Liang Jincong Inspector of Hezhou and enfeoffed him as King of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he made Liang Jincong, General Who Assists the State, inspector of Hezhou and enfeoffed him as King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，土斷雍州諸僑郡縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, land allocation was performed for all émigré commanderies and counties in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinwei, émigré registrations in Yongzhou were converted to permanent land allotments.

sentences.zh: 九月，建康、秣陵二縣各置都官從事一人，司水、火、劫、盜。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, in Jiankang and Molling counties one Capital Official Attendant each was established to oversee water, fire, robbery, and theft.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Jiankang and Molling counties each received an official to oversee cases of flood, fire, robbery, and theft.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，以百濟王余慶為鎮東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, the King of Baekje Yuying was made Grand General Who Guards the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, Yuying, King of Baekje, was made Grand General Who Guards the East.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，改封順陽王休范為桂陽王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, Prince of Shunyang Xiufan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, Prince Xiufan of Shunyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛亥，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on xinhai, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinhai, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復郡縣田秩，並九親祿奉。

translations.literal: On bingchen commandery and county field stipends were restored, together with salaries for the Nine Degrees of kin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen field stipends for commanderies and counties were restored, along with salaries for the nine degrees of imperial kin.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，拜初寧陵。

translations.literal: On renxu he paid homage at Chuning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he paid homage at Chuning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，衛將軍、尚書令建平王宏以本號開府儀同三司，以丹陽尹褚湛之為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingxu, the General of the Guard and Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jianping Hong, with his present title opened an office equal to the Three Dukes; the Administrator of Danyang Chu Zhanzhi was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingxu, Prince Hong of Jianping, General of the Guard and Director of the Masters of Writing, was granted an office with privilege equal to the Three Dukes; Chu Zhanzhi, administrator of Danyang, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，尚書令建平王宏薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingwei, the Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Jianping Hong, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei, Prince Hong of Jianping, Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以田農要月，命太官停殺牛。

translations.literal: On yimao, because it was a crucial month for field agriculture, the Imperial Kitchen was ordered to stop slaughtering cattle.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, as planting season demanded, the Imperial Kitchen was ordered to stop slaughtering cattle.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，立皇子子綏為安陸王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiashen, the imperial son Zisui was installed as Prince of Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiashen, Prince Zisui was enfeoffed as Prince of Anlu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，地震。

translations.literal: On xinchou there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，增置吏部尚書一人，省五兵尚書官。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuyin, one additional Director of the Masters of Writing for Personnel was established; the office of Director of the Masters of Writing for Arms was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, an additional Director of Personnel was appointed and the office of Director of Military Affairs was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，加左光祿大夫何尚之開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Left Grandee of Splendid Honors He Shangzhi was granted an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai He Shangzhi, Left Grandee of Splendid Honors, was granted an office with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙戌，中書令王僧達下獄死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingxu, the Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Sengda was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, Wang Sengda, Director of the Masters of Writing, was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，襄陽大水，遣使巡行振恤。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renxu, Xiangyang suffered great floods; envoys were dispatched to tour and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, floods struck Xiangyang; officials were sent to inspect and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，置武衛將軍、武騎常侍官。

translations.literal: On gengwu the offices of General of Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of Martial Cavalry were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the offices of General of Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of Martial Cavalry were established.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月己亥，制諸王及妃主庶姓位從公者，喪事聽設凶門，餘悉斷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on jihai, a rule was set that among princes and consorts of noble or common surname holding rank from marquis upward, funerals might set up mourning gates; all else was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, a rule allowed mourning gates at the funerals of princes and consorts of marquis rank and above; all other mourning displays were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、高麗、林邑等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the states of Henan, Goguryeo, Linyi, and others all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Henan, Goguryeo, Linyi, and other kingdoms all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月己丑，以領軍將軍柳元景為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on jichou, the General of the Guard Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jichou, Liu Yuanjing, General of the Guard, was made Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，以揚州所統六郡為王畿，以東揚州為揚州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, the six commanderies under Yangzhou's jurisdiction were made the Imperial Domain; Eastern Yangzhou was made Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, the six commanderies directly under Yangzhou were designated the imperial domain, and Eastern Yangzhou was reorganized as Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復置廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On jiazi the office of Supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the office of Supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review was restored.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，司空、南兗州刺史竟陵王誕有罪，貶爵，誕不受命，據廣陵反。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou, Prince of Jingling Yan, was guilty and degraded in rank; Yan did not accept the command, held Guangling, and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yimao, Prince Yan of Jingling, Minister of Works and inspector of Southern Yanzhou, was stripped of rank; he refused the order, seized Guangling, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 以沈慶之為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，討誕。

translations.literal: Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, with an office equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Yanzhou, to suppress Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry with privilege equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Southern Yanzhou, and sent to suppress Yan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，克廣陵城，斬誕，悉誅城內男丁，以女口為軍賞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, Guangling city was captured; Yan was beheaded; all male inhabitants within the city were put to death; women were taken as military reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jisi, Guangling fell; Yan was beheaded, every male in the city was executed, and the women were distributed as spoils of war.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴。

translations.literal: That day martial law was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day martial law was lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinwei a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以丹陽尹劉秀之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Administrator of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Liu Xiuzhi, administrator of Danyang, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，加南兗州刺史沈慶之位司空。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Inspector of Southern Yanzhou Shen Qingzhi was added to the rank of Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Shen Qingzhi, inspector of Southern Yanzhou, was promoted to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，於玄武湖北立上林苑。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renchen, the Shanglin Park was established north of Xuanwu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, the Shanglin Park was established north of Xuanwu Lake.

sentences.zh: 甲午，移南郊壇于牛頭

translations.literal: On jiawu the southern suburban altar was moved to Niutou
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the southern suburban altar was moved to Niutou

sentences.zh: 山，以正陽位。

translations.literal: Mountain, to align with the due-south position.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain to align with the due-south position.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，立皇后蠶宮于西郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, the empress's silkworm palace was established in the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, the empress's silkworm-raising hall was established in the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，置謁者僕射官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the office of Vice Director of Usher was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the office of Vice Director of Usher was established.

sentences.zh: 是歲，婆皇、河西、高麗、肅慎等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the states of Bohuang, Hexi, Goguryeo, Sushen, and others each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Bohuang, Hexi, Goguryeo, Sushen, and other kingdoms each sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 西域獻舞馬。

translations.literal: The Western Regions presented dancing horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Regions presented dancing horses.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛未，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on xinwei, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on xinwei, he sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宕昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the state of Dangchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the kingdom of Dangchang sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，親耕藉田，大赦。

translations.literal: On yihai he personally plowed the sacred field, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he personally performed the spring plowing rite in the sacred field and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立皇子子勳為晉安王，子房為尋陽王，子頊為曆陽王，子鸞為襄陽王。

translations.literal: On gengyin the imperial sons Zixun, Zifang, Zixu, and Ziluan were installed as Princes of Jin'an, Xunyang, Liyang, and Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Princes Zixun, Zifang, Zixu, and Ziluan were enfeoffed as princes of Jin'an, Xunyang, Liyang, and Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，皇后親桑于西郊。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiashen, the empress personally tended mulberry trees in the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, the empress personally performed the sericulture rite in the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，詔四時供限，詳減太半。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu, an edict ordered that seasonal tribute quotas be reduced by more than half in detail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingwu, an edict cut seasonal tribute quotas by more than half.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太宰江夏王義恭等表請封岱宗，詔不從。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, and others memorialized requesting to perform the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai; an edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Grand Preceptor Prince Yigong of Jiangxia and others petitioned to perform the feng and shan rites at Mount Tai; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔以都下疾疫，遣使存問，並給醫藥。

translations.literal: On xinyou, because pestilence had struck the capital, an edict dispatched envoys to inquire after the sick and provide medicine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict, citing plague in the capital, dispatched officials to inquire after the sick and supply medicine.

sentences.zh: 其亡者隨宜賑恤。

translations.literal: Those who had died—relief was given as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The families of the dead were granted relief as needed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，尚書左僕射褚湛之卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Chu Zhanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Chu Zhanzhi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司何尚之薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiaxu, the Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with an office equal to the Three Dukes, He Shangzhi, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiaxu, He Shangzhi, Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with privilege equal to the Three Dukes, died.

sentences.zh: 八月，雍州大水，甲寅，遣加賑恤。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yongzhou suffered great floods; on jiayin additional relief was dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month floods devastated Yongzhou; on jiayin additional relief was sent.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，改封襄陽王子鸞為新安王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Prince of Xiangyang Ziluan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Prince Ziluan of Xiangyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，遣新除司空沈慶之討緣江蠻。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengyin, the newly appointed Minister of Works Shen Qingzhi was dispatched to suppress the river-bank Man tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengyin, the newly appointed Minister of Works Shen Qingzhi was sent to suppress river-bank tribal raiders.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，改細作署令為左右禦府令。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, the Director of the Fine Works Office was renamed Left and Right Directors of the Imperial Workshop.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, the Director of the Fine Works Office was renamed Director of the Left and Right Imperial Workshops.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復置大司農官。

translations.literal: On bingxu the office of Grand Minister of Agriculture was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the office of Grand Minister of Agriculture was restored.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，幸廷尉寺，宥系囚。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, the sovereign visited the Court of Judicial Review and pardoned prisoners in custody.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, he visited the Court of Judicial Review and pardoned prisoners in custody.

sentences.zh: 魏遣使通和。

translations.literal: Wei sent envoys seeking peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei sent envoys seeking peace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸建康縣，原放獄囚。

translations.literal: On dingwei the sovereign visited Jiankang county and released prisoners from jail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he visited Jiankang county and released prisoners from jail.

sentences.zh: 倭國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Wa sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The kingdom of Wa sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏和平元年。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Heping of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year corresponded to the first year of Heping under the Wei.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊午朔，華雪降，散為六出，上悅，以為瑞。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on wuwu, the first day of the month, splendid snow fell, scattering in six-pointed flakes; the sovereign rejoiced and took it as an auspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the new year of the fifth year, fine snow fell in six-pointed flakes; the emperor rejoiced and took it as an auspicious omen.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，閱武，軍幢以下，普加班錫，多所原宥。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guisi, he reviewed the troops; from army banners downward all were generally granted insignia of honor, and many were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi, he reviewed the troops; officers and men were granted insignia of honor, and many offenders were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，行幸江乘，遣祭故太保王弘、光祿大夫王曇首墓。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu, he traveled in state to Jiangcheng and dispatched envoys to sacrifice at the tombs of the former Grand Tutor Wang Hong and Grandee of Splendid Honors Wang Tanshou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu, he traveled to Jiangcheng and sent envoys to sacrifice at the tombs of the late Grand Tutor Wang Hong and Wang Tanshou, Grandee of Splendid Honors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，改封西陽王子尚為豫章王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Prince of Xiyang Zishang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guisi, Prince Zishang of Xiyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，加尚書令柳元景左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On bingshen Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yuanjing was added as Left Grandee of Splendid Honors, with an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Liu Yuanjing, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Grandee of Splendid Honors with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雍州刺史海陵王休茂殺司馬庾深之，舉兵反，參軍尹玄慶起義，斬之，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Inspector of Yongzhou, Prince of Hailing Xiumao, killed the Chief Administrator Yu Shenzhi and raised an army in rebellion; the Staff Officer Yin Xuanqing rose in righteous cause, beheaded him, and sent the head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Prince Xiumao of Hailing, inspector of Yongzhou, killed Chief Administrator Yu Shenzhi and rebelled; Staff Officer Yin Xuanqing rose against him, beheaded him, and sent his head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 五月，起明堂于國學南丙巳之地。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Bright Hall was built south of the National University at the bingsi position.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Bright Hall was built south of the National University at the bingsi position.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，制帝室期親，官非祿官者，月給錢十萬。

translations.literal: On guihai a rule was set that among the emperor's kin within the mourning circle, those whose offices did not carry salary stipends were granted one hundred thousand cash monthly.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai a rule granted one hundred thousand cash monthly to imperial kin within the mourning circle who held offices without salary stipends.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingmao, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingmao, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，曲赦雍州。

translations.literal: On gengwu a partial amnesty was granted in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu a partial amnesty was granted in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，立皇子子仁為永嘉王，子真為始安王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, the imperial sons Ziren and Zizhen were installed as Princes of Yongjia and Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, Princes Ziren and Zizhen were enfeoffed as princes of Yongjia and Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以來歲修葺庠序，旌延國胄。

translations.literal: On jichou an edict ordered that in the coming year schools be repaired and extended, and imperial clansmen honored and fostered.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict ordered schools repaired and expanded in the coming year and imperial clansmen honored and supported.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，制方鎮所假白板郡縣，年限依台除，食祿三分之一，不給送故。

translations.literal: On gengyin a rule was set that provisional white-board commanderies and counties held by frontier commanders, their term limits following capital appointments, received one-third salary, with no parting gift.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin a rule fixed the terms of provisional commanderies and counties held by frontier commanders to match capital appointments, with one-third salary and no parting gift.

sentences.zh: 衛將軍東海王褘以本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The General of the Guard, Prince of Donghai Hui, with his present title opened an office equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Hui of Donghai, General of the Guard, was granted an office with privilege equal to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行幸琅邪郡，原遣囚系。

translations.literal: On dingmao he traveled in state to Langye commandery and released prisoners held in custody.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he traveled to Langye commandery and released prisoners held in custody.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河、濟清。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Yellow and Ji rivers ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Yellow and Ji rivers ran clear.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，初立馳道，自閶闔門至於朱雀門，又自承明門至於玄武湖。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingshen, for the first time imperial highways were established, from the Gate of Heaven's Brightness to the Gate of the Vermilion Bird, and again from the Gate of Proclaiming Brightness to Xuanwu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingshen, imperial highways were first established from the Gate of Heaven's Brightness to the Gate of the Vermilion Bird, and from the Gate of Proclaiming Brightness to Xuanwu Lake.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改封曆陽王子頊為臨海王。

translations.literal: On renyin Prince of Liyang Zixu was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince Zixu of Liyang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，以南徐州刺史劉延孫為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, the Inspector of Southern Xuzhou Liu Yansun was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiayin, Liu Yansun, inspector of Southern Xuzhou, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，以領軍將軍劉遵考為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renshen, General of the Guard Liu Zunkao was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, General of the Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 甲戊，制天下人戶歲輸布四匹。

translations.literal: On jiawu, it was decreed that each household in the realm should render four bolts of cloth annually.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict fixed the annual cloth levy at four bolts per household throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛卯，祀南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on xinmao, the southern suburbs were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on xinmao, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 是日，又宗祀文皇帝于明堂，以配上帝。

translations.literal: That same day, Emperor Wen was also sacrificed to in the Bright Hall, as consort to the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he performed the associated rite in the Bright Hall, honoring Emperor Wen as consort to the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置五官中郎將、左右中郎將官。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the offices of Commandant of the Five Officials and Left and Right Commandants of the Officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the offices of Commandant of the Five Officials and of the Left and Right Commandants of the Officials were established.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，復百官祿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yimao, official salaries were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, official salaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，立皇子子元為邵陵王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengyin, the imperial son Ziyuan was established as Prince of Shaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, the imperial son Ziyuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以倭世子興為安東將軍、倭國王。

translations.literal: On renyin, Prince Xing, heir of Wa, was made General Pacifying the East and King of Wa.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince Xing, heir of Wa, was made General Pacifying the East and King of Wa.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，新作大航門。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, the Great Bridge Gate was newly built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, the Great Bridge Gate was newly constructed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，置淩室於覆舟山，修藏冰之禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, an ice chamber was established on Fushan Mountain, and the rite of storing ice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, an ice chamber was built on Fushan Mountain and the ancient rite of storing ice was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，尚書左僕射劉延孫卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Yansun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Left Vice Director Liu Yansun died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，地震，有聲如雷，兗州尤甚，於是魯郡山搖者二。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen, there was an earthquake with a sound like thunder; Yanzhou was especially hard hit, and in Lu Commandery two mountains shook.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiashen, an earthquake shook the land with a sound like thunder; Yanzhou suffered most severely, and in Lu Commandery two mountains trembled.

sentences.zh: 乙未，立皇子子雲為晉陵王。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the imperial son Ziyun was established as Prince of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the imperial son Ziyun was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinling.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，置清台令官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yichou, the office of Director of the Bureau of Astronomy was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou, the office of Director of the Bureau of Astronomy was established.

sentences.zh: 九月，制沙門致敬人主。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, it was decreed that Buddhist monks must perform obeisance to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict required Buddhist monks to perform obeisance to the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以尚書右僕射劉遵考為左僕射，以丹陽尹王僧朗為右僕射。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made Left Vice Director, and Prefect of Danyang Wang Silang was made Right Vice Director.
